request.spec:
The rollover now also soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in
start-date order, each as a soft close would (PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED), after the ROLLOVER line.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The rollover now also soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in
start-date order, each as a soft close would (PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED), after the ROLLOVER line.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The rollover now soft-closes every still-open period of the old fiscal year, in start-date order, right after it writes the `ROLLOVER` audit line. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

- **New step:** `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/period/SoftCloseOldYear.java` picks the old year's periods that are neither closed nor soft-closed and closes each one through the same code a manual soft close uses. Each one gets its own `PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED` audit line.
- **Wiring:** in `rollover.POST.yml` the new step runs between `carry` and `respond`, inside the same transaction. That's what puts the soft-close lines after `ROLLOVER`.
- **No front-end or schema changes were needed.** Soft-closed periods already show as "soft" on screen.

Undoing a rollover does not reopen the periods it soft-closed. The request didn't mention undo and the test doesn't check it, so I left that as it was. Tell me if undo should reopen them too.
